---
# Positive control for attribute escaping. Unlike the two fixtures beside it,
# this poster must RENDER, and the characters below must survive to the PDF.
#
# A div attribute that becomes Typst content — a poster-box title, a takeaway
# or stats label — used to be interpolated raw. "#" opens code, so the grant
# number below read as a variable lookup; an unpaired "]" closed the content
# block early; "$" opened math. Each failed the compile with an error naming
# neither the attribute nor the div. The same text written in YAML has always
# escaped cleanly, which is the asymmetry this fixture pins down.
title: "Attribute escaping fixture"
format:
  sciposter-typst:
    poster:
      size: a2
      columns: 1
---

::: {.poster-box title="Effects n=42] at $5"}
Box body.
:::

::: {.takeaway label="Grant #DEB-1234"}
Headline finding.
:::
